translations.text: The revelation of Jesus Christ, through whom God granted that his servants be shown what is to happen soon. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,
who testified to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ—what he saw, what was, and what was to happen afterward.
Blessed are those who read the words of this prophecy, and the one who hears and keeps whatever is written in it, for the time is near.
From John to the seven churches in Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, who was, and who is to come, and from the seven powers of the Spirit who is before his throne,
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, who is the firstborn from the dead and ruler of the kingdoms of the earth. To him who loved us and released us from the bonds of our sins by his blood,
and made us kings and priests to his God and Father—to him be glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
Look, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him, and all the nations of the earth will mourn over him. Yes, amen.
“I am Ayb, and I am Keh,” says the Lord God, who was, who is, and who is to come, the Almighty.

I, John, your brother and fellow participant in the suffering, kingdom, and endurance that are in Christ Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
The Spirit came upon me on the Lord’s Day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet, saying to me, “I am Alpha and Omega, the First and the Last.
Write what you see in a book, and have it taken to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me, and when I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
and among the seven lampstands, someone like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching to his feet, with a golden belt around his chest.
His head and hair were like white wool and like snow, and his eyes were like a flame of fire.
His feet were like smoking bronze, glowing red in a furnace, and his voice was like the sound of many waters.
He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp, double-edged sword came out of his mouth. His face appeared radiant like the sun.
When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. He laid his right hand on me and said to me, “Do not be afraid. I am the Beginning, and I am the End.
I am life, and I am the one who died, and look, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. And I hold the keys of death and Hades.
Write what you see, what is, and what is going to happen afterward:
the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
To the angel of the church of the Ephesians write: This is what the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands says:
I know your works, your toil, and your endurance, and that you cannot tolerate evil people. You tested those who call themselves apostles but are not, and found them to be liars.
You endured and suffered for my name, and you labored.
But I say to you that you have abandoned your first love.
Remember now where you have fallen from, repent, and do your first works. Otherwise, I am coming soon and will move your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.
Now do this: hate the works of Nicolaus, which I hate.
Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes I will give food from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
And write to the angel of the church of Smyrna: Thus says the One without beginning and without end, who died and came to life:

I have seen your works, your distress, and your poverty—but your poverty will become greatness—and the blasphemy of those who said they were Jews and were nothing of the kind, but a synagogue of Satan.

Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the Devil is about to throw some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will have distress for ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear what the Holy Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
And write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: Thus says the one who has the sharp, double-edged sword:

I have seen your works and that you dwell where Satan's throne is. You hold to my name and did not deny my faith in the day when Antipas became my faithful witness—for every believer is my faithful witness—who was killed among you, who live where Satan dwells.

But I have a few things against you, because you have among you the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, so that they would eat food offered in sacrifice and commit sexual immorality.
Likewise, you also hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans, which I hate.
Therefore repent. Otherwise I will come quickly and wage war against them with the sword of my mouth.

Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes I will give food from the hidden manna, and I will give them the sacred inscription, with a new name written in the inscription, which no one knows except those who receive it.
And write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: Thus says the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire and whose feet are like smoking bronze.
I have seen your works, your love, your faith, and your service with endurance, for your later labor is greater than your earlier labor.

But I have much to say against you, because you have allowed the woman Jezebel, who called herself a prophet and taught my servants error, to commit sexual immorality and eat food offered in sacrifice.
And I gave them time to repent of their sexual immorality, but they did not repent.
Look, I am throwing her into a furnace, and her accomplices, with whom she committed adultery, into great afflictions, unless they repent of their deeds.
And I will kill their children with death, and all the churches will know that I am the one who lays bare the kidneys and hearts, and I give to each of you according to their deeds.
But I say to you who are in Thyatira and do not hold this teaching, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they call them: I will place no other burden on you.
But hold on to what you have until I come.
And to the one who overcomes and keeps my works until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
And they will shepherd them with an iron rod and shatter them like a potter's vessel.
Just as I also received from my Father, and I will give them the morning star.
Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
And write to the angel of the church of Sardis: Thus says the one who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I have seen your works, that you have a name for being alive, but you are dead.
Be watchful and stand firm from now on, for you are about to die, because I have not found your works complete before God.
Therefore remember how you heard, and keep it and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and no one will know of my coming to you.
You have a few names among the people of Sardis who have not soiled their clothes, and they walk in white, which they have become worthy to wear.
The one who overcomes will be clothed in white in this way, and his name will not be erased from the book of life. I will acknowledge his name before my Father and before the angels.
Let anyone who has ears hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
And write to the angel of the church of Philadelphia: Thus says the Holy One, the True One, who holds the key of David, who opens and no one can shut, and shuts and no one can open.
I saw your works. Look, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut, because you have a little strength and have kept my word and have not denied my name.
Look, I give you the synagogue of Satan, those who say they are Jews and are not, but lie. I will make them come and bow down before your feet and know that I have loved you.
Because you have kept my word of endurance, I too will keep you from the hour of your trial, which is to come upon the whole world to test all who live on the face of the earth.
Look, I am coming quickly. Hold on to what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

The one who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will never go outside again. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which is to descend from the heaven of my God, and his new name.
Let anyone who has ears hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
And write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: Thus says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the beginning of God's creation.
I know your works: you are neither cold nor hot. You ought to be either cold or hot.
But you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, and you are about to be vomited out of my mouth.
For you say, “I was rich and became wealthy, and I need nothing,” and you do not know that you are miserable and wretched and poor, naked and blind.

Now I will counsel you: buy from me gold tested by fire so that you may become rich, and white clothes so that you may dress yourself and the shame of your nakedness may not appear. Put medicine on your eyes so that you may see.
Those whom I love, I rebuke and discipline. Be zealous now and repent.
Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with me.
The one who overcomes, I will grant him to sit with me on my throne, just as I also overcame and sat on my Father's throne.
Let the one who has ears hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

After this I looked, and behold, the doors of heaven were open, and the voice of the first trumpet, which I had heard, was speaking with me and saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what is to happen afterward.”
Immediately I was in the Spirit, and behold, a throne was there in heaven.
And someone sat on the throne, resembling jasper and carnelian stones in appearance.

And priests surrounded the throne, resembling an emerald in appearance. Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white clothes, with golden crowns on their heads.
From the throne came flashes of lightning, voices, and thunder. Seven lamps of blazing fire burned before the throne; these are the seven Spirits of God.
Before the throne was a glass sea, like the whiteness of ice. In the midst of the throne and around the throne were four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.
The first living creature was like a lion, the second living creature was like a calf, the third living creature had a human face, and the fourth living creature was like a flying eagle.

Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and they were full of eyes all around and within. Day and night they never ceased saying, “Holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, who is, and you are [?], and you are to come.”
And whenever the living creatures gave glory and honor and thanks to the one seated on the throne, the one who lives forever and ever.
The twenty-four elders fell down before the one seated on the throne and worshipped the one who lives forever and ever. They laid their crowns before the throne and said:
“You are worthy, our holy Lord God, to receive glory and honor and power, because you created everything, and by your will they were created and remain established.”
And I saw in the right hand of the one seated on the throne a scroll written on the inside and outside and sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and undo its seals?”
And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll, for they did not see it.
And I wept bitterly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll and look into it.
And one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep. Look, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, from the root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and undo its seven seals.”

And I saw a slaughtered Lamb standing amid the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent throughout the whole earth.
And he came and received it from the right hand of the one seated on the throne.
And when he took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each had a harp and a golden censer full of incense, which is the prayers of the saints.

And they sang new songs of praise and said, “You are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, because you were slaughtered and purchased us for God with your blood from all nations and languages and assemblies of the Gentiles.
And you made them kings and priests for our God, to reign over the earth.”

And I saw and heard the voice of many angels who stood around the throne, the four living creatures, and the priests. Their number was tens of thousands of tens of thousands and thousands of thousands.
They said in a loud voice, “The slaughtered Lamb is worthy to receive greatness and wisdom and power and honor and glory and blessing.”
And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and in the sea, and those within them, saying, “May the one seated on the throne and the Lamb be blessed, exalted, and glorified forever and ever.”
And the four living creatures said, “Amen.” And the elders fell down before him and worshipped.
And I saw the Lamb open one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say, with a voice like thunder, “I am coming.”
And I looked, and there was a white horse. Its rider had a bow, and a crown was given to him. And the conqueror came to conquer.
And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “I am coming.”
And another horse came out, a red one. Its rider was granted the power to take peace from the earth, so that people would slaughter one another, and a great sword was given to him.
And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “I am coming.” And I looked, and there was a black horse. The one seated on it had a balance in his hand.
And I heard a voice from among the four living creatures: “A measure of wheat for one denarius, and three measures of barley for one denarius. And do not harm the oil and wine.”
And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, “I am coming.”

And I looked, and there was a pale green horse. The one seated on it had Death, and Hades followed him. And he was given authority over a fourth of the world, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and with the wild beasts of the earth.
And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw beneath the altar the souls of all the people slaughtered because of the word of God and because of his testimony, which they held.
They said in a loud voice, “How long, holy and true Lord, will you refrain from judging and avenging our blood on the inhabitants of the earth?”
And they were given white robes and told to rest a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants and their brothers, who were to meet their end as they had, was reached.
And I saw, when he opened the sixth seal, that there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like goat-hair sackcloth, and the whole moon became like blood.
And the stars of heaven fell to the earth like leaves from a fig tree when it is shaken violently by the wind.
And the heavens rolled up like a parchment scroll, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
And the kings of the earth, the rulers, the commanders of thousands, the great men, the powerful, every slave, and every free person hid themselves in caves and in the clefts of the rocks.
And they said to the mountains, “Fall on us,” and to the hills, “Cover us.”
For the great day of his wrath has come, and who can stand before him?
And after that I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so that no wind would blow on the earth, on the sea, or on the trees.
And I saw another angel rising from the east, holding the seal of the living God. He cried out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given authority to destroy the earth and the sea.
And he said, “Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees. Wait until I have sealed the servants of my God.”
And I heard the number of those who were sealed: there were one hundred and forty-four thousand sealed from the tribes of the children of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand were sealed.
From the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand were sealed.
From the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand were sealed.
From the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand were sealed.

And after this I looked, and behold, there was a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation, every tribe, every language, and every people, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
They cried out in a loud voice and said, “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.”
And all the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and grace belong to the Lord our God forever and ever. Amen!”
And one of the elders said to me, “Who are these who are clothed in white robes, and where do they come from?”
I said to him, “Lord, you know.” And he said to me, “These are those who come out of great tribulations, and they washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.”
For this reason they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple, and the one who sits on the throne dwells in them.
They will neither hunger nor thirst, and neither the sun nor scorching heat will strike them.
And the Lamb in the midst of his throne will shepherd them and lead them to the spring of life, of living water, for God wiped away every tear from their eyes.
And when he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
And I saw seven angels who stood before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
And another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a golden censer, and he was given much incense so that he might offer the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne.
And the smoke of the incense, the prayers of the saints, rose from the hands of the angels before God.
And the angel filled the censer with fire from the altar and threw it to the earth, and there was thunder, voices, lightning, and a great earthquake.
And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound them.

And the first angel sounded the trumpet, and there was hail and fire and blood mixed together, and it fell to the earth. It burned up a third of the earth, a third of the trees, and all the green grass.
And the second angel sounded the trumpet, and something like a great burning mountain fell into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.
And a third of the swimming creatures perished, and whatever had living breath was destroyed.
And the third angel sounded the trumpet, and a great star fell from heaven, blazing like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and springs.
And the star's name was Bitterness, and many died from the bitterness of the waters.
And the fourth angel sounded the trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon and a third of the stars. A third of them was darkened, and likewise a third of the night.

And I saw and heard the voice of an angel flying in midheaven, saying in a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth when the sound comes from the three remaining trumpets that the angels are about to sound!”
And the fifth angel sounded the trumpet, and I saw a star fall from heaven, and it was given the key to the pit of the abyss.
And smoke rose from the pit like smoke from a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened.
And locusts came out of the pit onto the earth, and they were given power like the stings of a scorpion.
And they were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any trees, but only the people on earth who did not have the seal on their foreheads.
And they were commanded not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the sting of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
And in those days people will seek death and will not find it. They will long to die, and death will flee from them.
And the appearance of the locusts was like that of a horse prepared for battle. On their heads was something like a crown resembling gold, and their faces were like human faces.
And their hair was like a woman's hair, and their teeth were like a lion's.
They had breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots drawn by many horses rushing into battle.
And they had tails like a scorpion's, with stings in their tails, and they had power to torment people for five months.
And they had as king over them the angel of hell. His name in Hebrew was Abaddon, which in the Armenian language is called Destruction.
Look, one woe has passed, and two woes are coming.
And the sixth angel sounded the trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four living creatures who were before the altar of God.
It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
And the four angels were released, who had been prepared for the hour and the day and the month and the year, to kill a third of humanity.
And the number of their mounted troops was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands. I heard their number.

And I saw horses in the vision, and riders on them who had fiery and hyacinth-colored breastplates burning with sulfur. The horses’ heads were like lions’ heads, and fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.
And a third of humanity died from these plagues: from the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur that came out of their mouths.
For their power is in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails were like snakes and had heads with which they destroyed the wicked.

And the rest of the people, who did not die from these plagues, did not repent or turn away from the works of their hands, from worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.
And they did not repent of their murders, their sorcery, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
And I saw another mighty angel descending from heaven, clothed in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire.
He had a little book open in his hand, and he placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the earth.
And he cried out with a loud voice, roaring like a lion. When he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.
And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have spoken, and do not write it down.”
And the angel whom I saw, who placed one foot on the sea and the other on dry land, raised his right hand to heaven.
And he swore by the one who lives forever, who established the earth and everything in it, that there would be no more time.
But in the days when the seventh angel sounds, when he blows the trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, which he proclaimed as good news through his servants the prophets.
And the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again and said, “Go, take the little book that the angel holds open in his hand, who stands on the sea and the dry land.”
And I went to the angel and asked him for it. He said to me, “Take this and eat it. It will become bitter in your stomach, but in your mouth it is sweet as honey.”
And I took the open little book from the angel and swallowed it. It was like honey in my mouth, but when I ate it, my stomach became bitter.
And he said to me, “You must prophesy again concerning peoples, nations, languages, and kings of the earth.”
And a reed like a staff was given to me, and the angel stood and said to me, “Rise and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those who worship in it.
But leave out the courtyard outside the temple, and do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
And I will give to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for one thousand two hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
These are the two olive trees and the two lamps that stand before God on the earth.
And if anyone wishes to harm them, fire will come out of their mouths and consume their enemies. And whoever wishes to wrong them will be killed in this way.

They have authority to shut the heavens so that no rain falls during the days of their prophecy. And they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
And when they have completed all the days of their testimony, then the beast that comes up from the abyss will wage war against them, overcome them, and kill them.
And their dead bodies will lie in the squares of their great city, which is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was also crucified.
And all tribes and peoples and all languages and nations will see them, for their dead bodies will lie there for three days, and they will not allow their bones to be buried in tombs.
And those who dwell on the earth rejoice and celebrate over them, even sending gifts and offerings to one another, because these two prophets will torment the inhabitants of the earth.
And after three and a half days, a living spirit from God will enter them, and they will rise and stand on their feet. And great dread and fear fell upon everyone who saw them.
And I heard a loud voice saying to them, “Rise, come up here!” And they went up to heaven in clouds, and their enemies saw them.

And at that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city sank, and seven thousand men died in the earthquake. After this, great fear came upon everyone, and they gave glory to the God of heaven.
Behold, the second woe has passed, and the third woe will come very soon.

And when the seventh angel sounded the trumpet, there was a voice in heaven saying, “The kingdom of the whole world has become the kingdom of our Lord and his Christ, and he will reign over everything forever and ever.”
And the twenty-four elders who sat on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped the Lord God, saying:
“We thank you, Lord God Almighty, who is and [?], because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.

The nations grew angry, and your wrath came, and the time came for the dead to be judged, and for you to reward your servants the prophets and the saints who fear your name, both small and great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
And God's temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of God appeared in his temple. There were flashes of lightning, voices, thunder, an earthquake, and great hailstones.
And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was pregnant and cried out in labor, and with great pain she was close to giving birth.
And another sign appeared in heaven: behold, a great fiery dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.

Its tail dragged a third of the stars of heaven and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when the woman gave birth to her son, the dragon would devour him.
And the woman gave birth to a male child who is destined to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod. Her son was snatched up to God and to his throne.
And the woman fled into the wilderness, where a place had been prepared for her by God, so that she would be fed there for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
And there was war in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon fought with its forces.
They could not withstand them, and no place was found for them in heaven.
And the great dragon fell—the ancient serpent who is called Beelzebul and Satan, who led the whole world astray—and its angels fell with it.

And I heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Now have come the power, the salvation, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Anointed One, for the accuser of our brothers has fallen, who accused them before God day and night.”
And they overcame it by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of his testimony, and they did not side with the dragon, even to the point of death.

Therefore, let the heavens rejoice, and all who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and the sea, because the Devil has fallen down to you, filled with great rage, and he will remain for only a short time.
And when the dragon saw that he had fallen to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
And the woman was given the two wings of a great eagle so that she could fly into the wilderness to her place, where she was fed for a time, times, and half a time, away from the serpent.
And the serpent poured water from its mouth after the woman to drown her.
And the earth helped the woman: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the water that the dragon had poured from its mouth.
And the dragon became enraged with the woman and went away to wage war against her other offspring, who kept God's commandments and held the testimony of Jesus.
And it stood on the sand of the sea.
And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had seven heads and ten horns, with ten crowns on its horns and a blasphemous name on its head.
And the beast I saw was like a leopard, its feet were like a bear’s, and its mouth was like a lion’s. And the dragon gave it his power, his throne, and great authority.
And one of its heads was mortally wounded, and its mortal wound was healing. And the whole earth marveled at the beast, because the dragon had given it his kingdom.
And they worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they said, “Who is like this beast, or who can wage war against it?”
And it was given a mouth to speak boasts and blasphemy, and it was given authority for forty-two months.
And it opened its mouth in blasphemy against God, and blasphemed his name, his dwelling, and the heavenly dwelling.
And it was given authority over all nations, languages, and peoples.
For all who dwell on the face of the earth will worship it, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the beginning of the world.
Let those who have ears to hear listen.
For there are some who will be led into captivity, some who will die by the sword, and some who will kill themselves. Here are the endurance and faith of the saints.
And I saw another beast coming up from the earth. It had two horns like a lamb’s and spoke like the dragon.
And it exercised all the authority of the first beast in its presence, and made the earth and all its inhabitants worship the first beast until its mortal wound healed.
And it performed many signs and made fire come down from heaven to earth before people.

And it led those who dwell on the earth astray through the signs it had been given power to perform before the beast. The inhabitants of the earth said to it, “Make an image of the beast that survived the wounds of the sword.”

And it was given authority to give a spirit to the image of the beast, so that the image would speak and all the inhabitants of the earth would worship it, and to kill anyone who did not worship the image of the beast.
And it will cause everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and enslaved, to be given a mark on their right hand and on their forehead.
And no one will be able to buy or sell unless they have the mark of the inscription, the name of the beast, and the number of its name.
Here is wisdom: let whoever has understanding calculate the number of the beast, which is the number of a human being. And the number of its name is this: six hundred sixty-six.
And I saw, and behold, the Lamb stood on Mount Zion, and with him were one hundred forty-four thousand who had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
And I heard a voice from heaven like the sound of many waters and the sound of loud thunder. And I heard something like the sound of harpists playing their harps.

And they sang new songs before the throne, before the four living creatures, and before the elders. And no one could learn their songs except the one hundred forty-four thousand who had been set free from the earth.
These are those who have not had intercourse with women, and they are virgins. These follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were chosen from among humanity before God and the Lamb.
And no lie was found in their mouths, for they are without blemish.
And I saw another angel flying in the midst of heaven, carrying everlasting good news to proclaim to all nations and languages dwelling on the earth.
And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. And worship the Creator of heaven and earth, the sea and the springs of water.”

And another angel, a second, followed him and said, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, because of the wine of the drunkenness of the wrath of her prostitution, with which she made all the nations drunk.”
And another angel, a third, followed them and said in a loud voice, “Anyone who worships the beast and its image, or receives the imprint of its mark on his forehead or on his right hand,
that person will drink from the cup of God’s wrath, poured undiluted into the cup of his anger, and will be tormented with fire and sulfur before God and the Lamb.
And their smoke will rise forever and ever. Those who worship the beast day and night, and those who worship its image and receive its mark and its name, have no rest.
Here is the endurance of the saints: those who keep God’s commandments and faith in Jesus.”

And I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, “Write: Blessed are the dead who have fallen asleep in the Lord now.” The Spirit says this at once, for they have rested from their labors, but their deeds alone followed them.
And I looked, and behold, there was a white cloud, and on the cloud sat someone like a son of man, with a golden crown on his head and a sharpened sickle in his hand.

And another angel came out of heaven, crying out in a loud voice and saying, “You who sit on the cloud, send out your sickle and reap, for the time of reaping has come, and the harvests of the earth are ripe.”
And the one sitting on the cloud cast his sickle onto the earth and harvested all the inhabitants of the earth.
And another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharpened sickle.

And another angel came out from the altar, who had authority over fire. He cried out in a loud voice to the angel who had the sharpened sickle and said, “Gather the clusters from the vineyard of the earth, for its grapes are ripe.”
And the angel cast his sickle onto the earth and gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God.
And the winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress up to the horses’ bridles, extending for one thousand six hundred stadia.
And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels who had seven final plagues, for through them God’s anger was brought to completion.
And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Those who had overcome the beast and its image and the number of its name and its mark stood on the sea of glass and held harps of God.
And they sang the song of Moses before God and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of all nations.
And who will not fear and glorify your holy name? For you alone are holy and worthy of worship. For all nations will come and worship before you, Lord, when your righteousness is revealed.”
And after this I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of testimony in heaven was opened.
And the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple, dressed in clean, bright linen, with golden belts around their chests.
And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
And the temple was filled with smoke from God’s glory and his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
And I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of God’s wrath onto the earth.”
And the first angel went and poured out his bowl onto the earth, and terrible afflictions came upon the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
And the second angel poured his bowl into the sea, and the waters turned into the blood of a dead person, and every living creature in the sea died.
And the third angel poured his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood.
And I heard the angel saying, “Righteous is the One who is, and he is holy in his works, for he judged in this way.
For the ungodly shed the blood of the saints and the blood of the prophets. Therefore he gave them blood to drink, as they deserved.”
And I heard a voice from the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are righteous and true.”
And the fourth angel poured from his bowl onto the sun.
And he was given power to scorch people with fire. People were scorched by intense heat and blasphemed God, who has authority over these plagues, and they did not repent to give glory to God.
And the fifth angel poured from his bowl onto the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became dark, and they chewed their tongues because of their painful suffering.
And they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their bitter suffering, and they did not repent of their deeds.
And the sixth angel poured from his bowl onto the great river Euphrates, and its waters dried up, so that I prepared [?] the way for the king from the east.
And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
For they were demonic spirits that performed signs and went to the kings of the whole earth to gather them for battle on the great day of the Lord Almighty. For the Lord said this:
“Look, I am coming like a thief. Blessed are those who stay awake and keep their clothes, so that they do not walk naked and their shame is not exposed.”
And they gathered them in a place called Armageddon in Hebrew.
And the seventh angel poured from his bowl onto the air, and a loud voice came from heaven and from the throne, saying, “It is done.”

And there were flashes of lightning, voices, and thunder, and there was a great earthquake, such as had never occurred from the beginning, since humanity came to be on the earth—so great was that earthquake.
And the great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. And Babylon the Great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of his furious anger.
And every island fled, and the mountains were removed from their midst.

And great hail, each hailstone weighing about one talent, came down from heaven upon people. And the people blasphemed God in heaven because of the plague of hail, for the plague was great and severe.
And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here, and I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits upon many waters,
with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and the inhabitants of the earth became drunk on the intoxicating wine of her prostitution.”

And he carried me away in the Spirit into the wilderness, and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast, which was covered with a blasphemous name. And the beast that I saw had seven heads and ten horns.
And the woman was dressed in purple and scarlet and adorned with gold, pearls, and precious stones. She held a golden cup in her hand, and it was full of abominable and unclean prostitution.
And on her forehead a name was written as a mystery: “Babylon the Great, mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.”
And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of all the witnesses. And when I saw her, I was greatly astonished.
And the angel said to me, “Why were you astonished? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has seven heads and ten horns.

And the beast you saw was and is not, and is about to come up from hell and go to destruction. Everyone living on the earth whose name had not been written in the book of life from the beginning of the world marveled at the beast you were seeing, because it was and is not and is near.
Here is wisdom for one who has understanding: the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman was seated, and they are seven kings, and there being seven kings.
Five fell, and one remained, and one has not come. When he comes, he has only a little time.
And the beast that was and is not is itself the eighth, and is one of the seven, and is going to destruction.
And the ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but they receive it and are rulers for one hour, and they receive authority with the beast.
These have one purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
And they wage war against the Lamb, and the Lamb conquers them, because he is their Lord and the King of kings. Those with him are called, chosen, and faithful.
And he said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was sitting, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.”
And the ten horns of the beast that you saw will see the prostitute and hate her, and they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
For God put it into their hearts to have one purpose and to give their kingdom to the beast until the word of God is fulfilled.
And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kingdoms of the earth.
And after this I saw another angel coming down from heaven, who had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.

And he cried out with a loud voice, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen! She has become a dwelling place for demons, a place of confinement for every unclean spirit, and a prison holding every impure and hated spirit.”

For all the nations drank of the fury of the wine of her prostitution, and the kings of the earth committed prostitution with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the increase of her power.
And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Come out of her, my people, so that you do not share in her sins and do not receive her plagues.”
For her sins have piled up and reached heaven, and God has remembered her wicked deeds.
And he repays her as she repaid us, and let her receive double according to her deeds. In the cup in which she mixed, mix a double portion for her.
As much as she glorified herself and rejoiced, give her that much grief, because she said in her heart, “I will always sit as queen, and I will never be a widow.”
Therefore her plagues will come upon her in a single day: death, mourning, and famine. And she will be burned with fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judged her.
And the kings of the earth who committed prostitution with her and made merry will weep and mourn over her, and they will groan when they see the smoke of the burning of her torment.
They will stand far away for fear of her torment and say, “Woe to you, great city Babylon, mighty city, for in one hour your judgments have come upon you!”
And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over you, because no one buys their cargo.

And there will no longer be profit from you in gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, gold thread, scarlet cloth, every kind of incense wood, every ivory vessel, and every vessel made of precious wood, bronze, iron, or earthenware,

and cinnamon, every kind of incense, oil, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, livestock of every kind—cattle and sheep—and horses and chariots, which are suitable for the bodies and souls of human beings.
And everything your soul desired has gone from you, and all the shining splendor—the rich, the fat, and the white—has gone from you, and you will no longer find it.
And all the merchants who became rich through these things will stand far away from you for fear of your torment, weeping and mourning.
They will say, “Alas, alas, great city, you who were clothed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet gilded with gold, and in precious stones and pearls!
For in a single hour all your greatness has vanished.” And every shipmaster, everyone who sails from place to place, the sailors, and all who work with nets will stand far away, weeping.
And they will cry out when they see the smoke of her burning, saying, “What city is like this great city?”

And they will throw dust on their heads and, wailing loudly, weeping and mourning, will say, “Alas, alas, great city, through which all of us who had ships on the seas became rich because of your wealth! Why were you destroyed and brought to ruin in a single hour?”
Rejoice over her, heaven, and holy apostles and prophets, for God has carried out your judgment against her.
And a mighty angel took a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, “Thus will Babylon, the great city, fall with violence and never be found again.”
And the sound of harpists, skilled musicians, trumpeters, and the drum will no longer be heard in you.

And there will no longer be the light of a lamp or the sound of a mill in you, and the voice of a bridegroom and the voice of a bride will no longer be heard in you, nor will your merchants—the distinguished and great men of the earth who delighted in you—be there, because all nations were led astray by the sorcery of your potions.
And in you was found all the blood of prophets and saints, and of all those recorded [?] in the land of the living.
And after this I heard the loud voice of a multitude in heaven saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and honor and power belong to our God,
for his judgments are true and just, because he judged the great prostitute for her prostitution and exacted vengeance from her for the blood of his servants.”
And a second time they offered praise and said, “Hallelujah!” And her smoke rose forever and ever.
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who sat on the throne of glory, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
And a voice came from the throne, saying, “Praise our God, all his servants and all who fear him, both small and great.”
And I heard the voice of a great multitude, like the sound of many waters and like the sound of mighty thunder, saying again, “Hallelujah! For our God, the Almighty, has begun to reign.
We rejoice and exult and give him glory, for the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife, his bride, has prepared herself.”
And she was given fine linen to wear, white, pure, and shining; the fine linen is the righteousness of the saints.
And one of the elders said to me, “Write this: Blessed are all who have been invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.”

And I fell at his feet and worshiped him. And he said to me, “Listen! Do not fall down before me, for I too am a fellow servant of yours and of your brothers who have the testimony of Jesus Christ. Worship the Lord God alone, for your vision and the spirit of your prophecy come through Jesus’ confirmation, because the testimony of Jesus comes through the Holy Spirit who was in the prophets.”
And I saw heaven opened, and there was a white horse. The one riding it was Faithful and True, and he judges and wages war in righteousness.
And his eyes were a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns. He had a name written that no one knows except himself.
And he wore a garment stained with blood, and his name was called the Word of God.
And the commanders of heaven and the armies of heaven followed him on horses, clothed in pure white linen.
And from his mouth came a sharp sword, so that with it he might strike the nations. He will shepherd them with an iron rod, and he will tread the winepress of the furious wrath of God Almighty.
And on his robe and on his limbs he had an inscription written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
And I saw another angel standing on the sun. He cried out with a loud voice to all the birds flying in midheaven, saying, “Come, gather for the great supper of God,
and eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of mighty men, the flesh of horses and all who ride them, and the flesh of free people and slaves, great and small.”
And I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies gathered to wage war against the one riding the white horse and against his army.

And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet, who performed signs before it and deceived those he had caused to receive the beast’s mark and those who worshiped its image. They were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
And the others were killed by the sword of the rider on the horse, the sword that came from his mouth, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
And I saw another angel descending from heaven, holding the keys of hell and a great chain in his hand.
He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

And he threw him into the abyss of hell, shut it, and sealed him in, so that he would no longer deceive the nations until the thousand years were completed. After that, he must be released for a short time.

And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and authority to judge was given to them to examine the souls of those tortured because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast and had not received its mark on their foreheads or on their right hands. And they stood and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
And after this, none of the dead came forth until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

Blessed are the holy ones who have a share in the first resurrection. The second death has no authority over them, but they will be priests of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, and they will reign with him for a thousand years.

And after the thousand years, he will release Satan and bring him out of prison. Satan will go out and deceive all the nations in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, and undertake to gather with them all the armies for battle. Their number is like the sand of the sea.
And they will advance over the breadth of the earth and surround the camps of the holy ones and the beloved city.
And fire will descend from heaven, from God, and consume them and their commander, Satan, who deceived them. And he will throw them into the sea of fire and sulfur, where the beast was,
and the false prophet, and they will be tormented day and night.
And I saw a great white throne and one seated on it. Heaven and earth were afraid and fled from his presence, and no place was found for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. Books were opened, and another book was opened, the book of life. And the dead were judged from what was written, according to their deeds.
And the sea gave up its dead, and death and hell gave up their dead, and each was judged according to their deeds.
Death and hell were delivered into the lake of fire.
And anyone who was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
And I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, descending from God and from heaven, adorned and prepared like a bride for her husband.
And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Behold, God's dwelling is among human beings, and he will dwell with them. They will be his people, and he will be their God.”
And he will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death will no longer exist, nor mourning, nor crying, nor pain, nor toil, for the former things have passed away.
And the one seated on the throne said to me, “Behold, I make everything new.” And he said to me, “Write: these words are true and trustworthy.”
And he said to me, “It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To those who thirst I give freely from the spring of the water of life.”
Whoever conquers will inherit all these things, and I will be their God, and they will be my children.

But the lazy, the unbelieving, murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, poisoners, and all lying evildoers—their portion is in the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.
And one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls filled with the seven final destructions came to me and spoke with me, saying, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
And he carried me away in the Spirit to a high and great mountain and showed me the great and holy city, Jerusalem, which had descended from heaven, from God.
And it had the glory of God, and its radiance resembled precious stones, a jasper stone, crystal-like and living.
And its walls were great and high, and it had twelve gates, and at the twelve gates were twelve angels. Their individual names were written above the gates according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
On the eastern side were three gates, on the northern side three gates, on the southern side three gates, and on the western side three gates.
And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
And the one speaking with me held a golden reed in his hand to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
And the city was square, and its width and height were equal to its length. Its length measured twelve thousand stadia, and its width and height were of the same measure—a cube.
And he measured its wall: one hundred and forty-four stadia, by a human measure, which is also an angel's.
And the walls of the city were built of jasper, and the city was pure gold, like clean, white glass.
And the foundations of the city were of every kind of precious stone. The first foundation of the wall was jasper, the second sapphire, the third a copper-colored stone, the fourth emerald,
the fifth onyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
And the twelve gates were made of twelve pearls of the same form, and each individual gate was made of a single pearl. And the city's broad open space was pure gold, like clear glass.
And I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb were its temple.
And the city had no need of the sun or the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God illuminated it at all times, and the Lamb was its lamp.
And the nations walked in its light, and the kings of the earth were clothed in light from its glory.
And its gates were not shut by day or by night, but remained open continually, and there was no longer any night in it.
but the glory and honor of the nations
And no one malicious or unclean, and no falsehood, will enter there, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.
And he showed me a pure river of living water, crystal-like, flowing from the throne of God and the Lamb.

And it flowed through the city's public squares. Along the riverbank, on this side and that, was the tree of life, bearing twelve fruits; each month they yielded their fruit, and the tree's leaves were for the healing of the nations.
And there were no more curses there, and the throne of God and his Lamb was in it, and his servants worshiped him.
And they saw his face, and his name was written on their foreheads.
And there was no night there, and there was no need there for a lamp or the light of the sun, because the Lord God gave them light. And they will reign forever and ever.
And he said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true, and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show his servant what must happen soon.”
“Look, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps these words of prophecy.”
And I, John, heard and saw all these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down and worshiped the angel who showed me all these things.
And he said to me, “Do not fall down before me and worship me, for I too am a fellow servant of yours and of your brothers who keep the words of the prophecy of this book. Worship God.”
And he said to me again, “Do not seal the prophetic words of this book, because the time is near.

Let the one who is to act wickedly act wickedly, and let the one who is to become filthy become filthy, and let the one who is to become righteous become righteous, and let the one who is to become holy become holy.”
“Look, I am coming soon, and my reward is with me, to repay each person according to their deeds.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last.”
Blessed are those who keep his commandments. They have the right to eat from the tree of life and to enter the city through its gates.
But let the dogs, sorcerers, murderers, idolaters, and all who love falsehood go outside.
“I, Jesus, sent my angel to testify to these things to you, the churches. I am the root and descendant of David, and the bright morning star.”
And the Spirit and the Bridegroom [?] “I am the one who is to come.” And let the one who hears say, “Come.” And let whoever is thirsty come, and whoever wishes take the water of life freely.
And I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to it, God will add to that person the seven plagues written in this book.
And if anyone takes away from the words of the prophecy of this book, God will reduce and cut off that person’s share in the tree of life and in the holy city described in this book.
The one who testified to these things said, “I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus Christ.

The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be upon all the saints. Amen.
END OF THE NEW TESTAMENT
